name: Minor Manifestation of Water
summary: Along North Tide's Run, the Minor Manifestation of Water waits for shamans on Silverpine Forest's coast. First, its corrupted counterpart must be defeated before the peaceful spirit will speak.

sections.title: A Spirit of the Western Tides
sections.body: West of the Sepulcher, the Minor Manifestation of Water waits along North Tide's Run. For a shaman in training, meeting the spirit is an essential rite. Water elementals embody life, renewal, and fluidity, yet a malevolent blight can corrupt them. An initiate must face and defeat a corrupted manifestation before the pure spirit reveals itself. Once the corruption is cleansed, the spirit guides shamans on their sacred journey to fashion a Water Totem.

faq.q: Where can I find the Minor Manifestation of Water?
faq.answer: Find the Minor Manifestation of Water along North Tide's Run, on Silverpine Forest's western coast just west of the Sepulcher.

faq.q: Why is the elemental hostile when I first approach?
faq.answer: A shaman must first summon and destroy the Corrupt Minor Manifestation of Water. After it falls, the peaceful manifestation appears and speaks with you.
The Minor Manifestation of Water guides shamans through the Call of Water chain, which ultimately teaches them to cast their Water Totem.

faq.q: Can non-shamans interact with this spirit?
faq.answer: The Minor Manifestation of Water guides shamans through their spiritual trials. Other adventurers have little reason to seek the spirit.

angles.text: As a shaman, cleanse the corruption from this elemental and receive its blessing. Then attune to the tides and forge your Water Totem.
As a troll, orc, or tauren shaman, you travel from Kalimdor to Lordaeron's shores to commune with this spirit.
